# Internal NoteChange keeps row mutation before tree notification

NoteChange leaves the scriptable interface and returns void, but the tree callback contract remains. The selected removal and insertion callers update row arrays before notification because RowCountChanged can query the new row count. The implementation still gates notifications on attached trees and suppression, toggles the removal flag, and clears cached headers after row changes. Existing expand/collapse checks assert resulting counts; they do not directly prove reference counts, every callback ordering or callback success. No test ran.

Scope: Native message view row notifications.
